description: Search Cutshort, the India tech hiring site, by skill or role keyword and city. Returns one row per job with title, company, locations, remote type, experience, salary as shown, skills, posted date, and description.

cities.description: Indian cities, for example Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Pune, or Chennai. Each keyword runs once per city. Leave empty for all of India.

dedupe.description: yes (default) returns a job once per run even when several searches list it. Repeats are not charged.

include_description.description: yes (default) adds the full job description as plain text. The price is the same either way.

keywords.description: Skill or role keywords, for example python, java, devops, or product management. Each keyword is matched to a Cutshort listing page, and the row says which page it used. From Clay, wrap a column in a one item list.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_jobs_per_search.description: Jobs to return per keyword and city, 1 to 50. A Cutshort listing page shows its newest 50 jobs.

remote_only.description: yes keeps only jobs Cutshort labels remote_only or remote_okay. Jobs left out are not charged.

start_urls.description: Cutshort listing pages (https://cutshort.io/jobs/...) or job pages (https://cutshort.io/job/...).

name: search_cutshort_jobs
title: Search Cutshort jobs
